canonical_description_zh: Execution Evidence Bridge 是一条可运行的 AI Agent 执行证据链：MVK 证明 AI 做过什么，Agent Evidence 把证明打包并验证，Verifiable Agent Demo 给审阅者和 agent 一条最短的跨栈复核路径。
canonical_description_en: Execution Evidence Bridge is a runnable AI execution evidence path: MVK proves what happened, Agent Evidence packages and verifies the proof, and Verifiable Agent Demo provides the shortest cross-stack verification walkthrough.
